capture.coverage: One session per OpenClaw session key for agent databases (every window: resets, isolated cron and heartbeat runs; cron run keys fold into their job); one per transcript for the pre-2026.8 JSONL store. Agent schema 19-31 transcript rows (JSON, or zstd from schema 23) and verified cold archives (file or SQLite, from schema 21), plus the JSONL store (`sessions/*.jsonl` with its `sessions.json` index), full entry tree with native entry IDs, user/assistant/thinking/tool content, toolCallId joins and isError outcomes; session key, agent ID and channel retained as metadata; heartbeat and wake prompts are controls. A session the agent database holds is read from it, never also from JSONL.

Assistant per-message usage with reported cost, one request per provider responseId; delivery mirrors, transcript-only rows and CLI-harness rows carry no request usage. Session windows, previous session and parent/spawn keys retained as metadata; no relationship, resume or live execution advertised. Reset/delete archives, compaction checkpoints and the doctor's import archive are not read; a deleted session retires.
